courses.title: Session 1 — Arrival — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 1, Arrival. “What makes a place feel safe to you?” Game: Dirty Feet.

courses.title: Session 2 — Arrival — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 1, Arrival. “How do you show up when nobody here knows you yet?” Game: Overhook-Underhook Starting Position Game.

courses.title: Session 3 — Arrival — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 1, Arrival. “What are you like before you trust the room?” Game: Hand Fight with Progression Game.

courses.title: Session 5 — Mask — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 2, Mask. “What version of you shows up here, and where did you learn it?” Game: Open Guard Multiple Connection Game.

courses.title: Session 6 — Mask — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 2, Mask. “What does your mask protect you from?” Game: Guard Retention Connection Game.

courses.title: Session 7 — Crack — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 3, Crack. “What happens to your mask when you're losing?” Game: Closed Guard Opening, Hands on Body.

courses.title: Session 8 — Crack — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 3, Crack. “What slips out of you when you get tired and stop performing?” Game: Feet-Off Guard Passing Game.

courses.title: Session 9 — Crack — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 3, Crack. “When you crack, what's the first thing that shows?” Game: Knee Pit Touchdown Game.

courses.title: Session 10 — Reveal — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 4, Reveal. “What's under the version you show people?” Game: Around-the-Legs Passing Game.

courses.title: Session 11 — Reveal — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 4, Reveal. “What part of you have you been hiding, even from yourself?” Game: Half Guard Side-Position Game.

courses.title: Session 12 — Reveal — The Descent
courses.summary: Week 4, Reveal. “If the mask came off in here, who would we meet?” Game: Open Guard Takedown and Escape Game.

courses.title: Session 13 — Contact — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 5, Contact. “What happens in you when someone makes real contact?” Game: Chest to Chest Under Elbows Maintenance.

courses.title: Session 14 — Contact — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 5, Contact. “How much of someone else do you actually let in?” Game: Chest-to-Chest Elbow Control Game.

courses.title: Session 15 — Contact — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 5, Contact. “Who are you with other people, now that you've met yourself?” Game: Mount, Stay Under Both Elbows (Continuous).

courses.title: Session 16 — Friction — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 6, Friction. “What do you do when someone pushes back?” Game: Mounted and Side Control Pin Game.

courses.title: Session 17 — Friction — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 6, Friction. “Can you stay present when it gets uncomfortable?” Game: Wrist Pin Game.

courses.title: Session 18 — Friction — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 6, Friction. “What does your friction do to the people across from you?” Game: Hip Control Breakdown Game.

courses.title: Session 19 — Rupture — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 7, Rupture. “What breaks in you when a connection breaks?” Game: Riding Bottom Position Game.

courses.title: Session 20 — Rupture — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 7, Rupture. “Have you ever broken something with someone and left it broken?” Game: Mount Head and Arm Trap Game.

courses.title: Session 21 — Rupture — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 7, Rupture. “When something breaks, what part is yours to own?” Game: Arm Lock Breaking Position Game.

courses.title: Session 22 — Repair — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 8, Repair. “What does it take for you to say sorry and mean it?” Game: Perpendicular Chest-to-Chest Pin Game.

courses.title: Session 23 — Repair — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 8, Repair. “Can you stay when leaving would be easier?” Game: Guard Recovery with Passing Resistance Game.

courses.title: Session 24 — Repair — The Initiation
courses.summary: Week 8, Repair. “What does repair cost you, and is it worth paying?” Game: Hunt for Hips and Shoulders (Perpendicular Start).
